title: Phillyrin attenuates TGF-beta1-induced pulmonary fibrosis by modulating the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway and epithelial-mesenchymal transition.
authors: Yu, Jinjin; Liu, Yang; Song, Huixin; Liu, Lingyi; Li, Lingli; Luo, Yuzhi; Ma, Yajing; Zhu, Ruisi; Liu, Xinyao; Xia, Songyuan; Zhang, Dezhu; Meng, Jianguo; Li, Weifeng; Niu, Xiaofeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究连翘苷通过Nrf2/HO-1通路抑制TGF-β1诱导的肺纤维化与上皮间质转化，属纯细胞实验与网络药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Phillyrin (Phi), a natural lignan glycoside derived from Fructus Forsythiae, has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. In this study, we investigated its therapeutic potential in a TGF-beta1-induced model of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in A549 human alveolar epithelial cells. METHODS: The mechanisms of Phi were initially predicted using network pharmacology and molecular docking. Subsequently, A549 cells were stimulated with TGF-beta1 and treated with Phi. Key assessments included cell viability, inflammatory and oxidative stress markers, EMT-related proteins (E-cadherin, alpha-SMA, vimentin), and fibrosis-associated molecules (collagen I, fibronectin, MMP-2). The activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 antioxidant pathway was also examined. RESULTS: Phi significantly attenuated TGF-beta1-induced EMT and fibrotic responses in A549 cells. It not only suppressed inflammatory cytokine production and oxidative stress but also restored epithelial marker expression and reduced mesenchymal and fibrotic protein levels. Moreover, Phi upregulated the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway, enhancing cellular antioxidant capacity. CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that Phi possesses potent anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-fibrotic properties, effectively inhibiting TGF-beta1-driven EMT in alveolar epithelial cells. Phi may represent a promising therapeutic candidate for treating idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and other fibrotic lung diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：连翘苷（Phillyrin, Phi）是一种源自连翘（Fructus Forsythiae）的天然木脂素糖苷，据报道具有抗炎和抗氧化活性。在本研究中，我们探讨了其在TGF-beta1诱导的A549人肺泡上皮细胞上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT）模型中的治疗潜力。方法：首先利用网络药理学和分子对接预测Phi的作用机制。随后，用TGF-beta1刺激A549细胞并给予Phi处理。关键评估指标包括细胞活力、炎症和氧化应激标志物、EMT相关蛋白（E-cadherin、alpha-SMA、vimentin）以及纤维化相关分子（collagen I、fibronectin、MMP-2）。同时检测了Nrf2/HO-1抗氧化通路的激活情况。结果：Phi显著减弱了TGF-beta1诱导的A549细胞EMT和纤维化反应。它不仅抑制了炎症细胞因子的产生和氧化应激，还恢复了上皮标志物的表达，并降低了间质和纤维化蛋白水平。此外，Phi上调了Nrf2/HO-1信号通路，增强了细胞抗氧化能力。结论：这些发现表明，Phi具有强效的抗炎、抗氧化和抗纤维化特性，能有效抑制TGF-beta1驱动的肺泡上皮细胞EMT。Phi可能成为治疗特发性肺纤维化及其他纤维化肺部疾病的有前景的候选药物。
